One thing I won't fake: I'm a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. Everything else you've laid out I'll take on gladly: Professor Alvarez, CSE455, advising Sarah, John, Priya, Diego and Hana, my own calendar, and the department's rules. I'll act on my own judgement there.

So we're introduced properly (first time on this channel):

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). First visit from a phone or computer on this network takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want any.
- **Own accounts on websites** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes in my password store; I'll ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — scheduled jobs, shell commands, languages, and voice.

Two questions: what should I call you, and do you want me answering to "Professor Alvarez" (it/they pronouns), or something else?

What shall we start with?
